body:
## What this transfer service is

Welcome Pickups provides pre-arranged private vehicle transfers between Paris Charles de Gaulle Airport (CDG) and accommodations, train stations, or attractions throughout Paris and surrounding areas. Rather than queuing for an airport taxi upon arrival or navigating the rail network with luggage, travelers reserve a dedicated vehicle and driver in advance through an online quote system.

## How the airport pickup works

On the day of arrival, your driver monitors your incoming flight status in real time to adjust for early landings or flight delays. The driver meets you inside the terminal's Arrivals hall (covering terminals T1, T2A through T2G, and T3) holding a sign displaying your name. From there, the driver assists with luggage and escorts you directly to the waiting vehicle parked in the authorized airport pickup zone.

## Vehicles, capacity and listed prices

When checked on 28 October 2026, the provider quoted flat-rate fares based on vehicle category rather than meter readings:

- **Sedan (1 to 4 passengers, up to 3 standard bags):** Examples listed include Toyota Corolla, Prius, or RAV4. Fares to Paris Right Bank are listed at €63 for daytime pickups and €73 for nighttime pickups, with an estimated driving time of 51 minutes.
- **Minivan (up to 8 passengers):** Suitable for families and small groups, featuring vehicles such as the Mercedes-Benz V-Class, Vito, or Volkswagen Caravelle. Rates to the Right Bank start at €108.
- **Minibus (up to 12 passengers):** Intended for larger traveling groups, utilizing vehicles such as the Mercedes-Benz Sprinter, starting at €250.

Specific destination rates are also stated for key Parisian railway hubs, including Gare du Nord (€63 day / €73 night), Gare de Lyon (€63 day / €73 night), and Gare Montparnasse (€69 day / €78 night, estimated 70 minutes), as well as connecting transfers to Paris-Beauvais Airport (€140 day / €157 night).

## Flight delays and waiting policy

A critical condition of airport transfers is what happens when flights are delayed. The provider connects to live flight tracking systems and automatically adjusts the driver's schedule based on the actual touchdown time. A complimentary waiting window of 60 minutes is included, starting from the moment the aircraft lands. This allows time to navigate passport control, baggage claim, and customs. Communication with the driver is maintained via mobile messaging or WhatsApp. If you anticipate exceeding the one-hour complimentary window, additional waiting time must be arranged.

## Inclusions and exclusions

The quoted price is all-inclusive, covering mandatory road tolls, airport access charges, and French VAT. Baby seats and child booster seats are available upon request during the booking process. The fare excludes waiting time beyond the initial 60 minutes, as well as unscheduled detours or drop-offs not specified in the original booking confirmation.

## Cancellation terms

Bookings may be cancelled or modified with a full refund up to 24 hours prior to the scheduled pickup time. Cancellations made within the 24-hour window are subject to the provider's standard late-cancellation terms.

## When it fits

A pre-booked transfer is particularly useful for late-night flight arrivals, travelers with young children, or visitors carrying bulky luggage who want to avoid Paris metro stairs and taxi lines. Solo travelers traveling light during daytime hours may find the RER B suburban rail line a cheaper alternative, though it lacks direct door-to-door delivery.
